summary: A 40-year-old Tennessee woman slipped on wet rocks and fell into the St. Vrain River about a mile from the Wild Basin trailhead, was swept about 150 yards downstream and managed to pull herself onto a rock and log. The park SAR team and the Estes Valley Fire dive/swiftwater team reached her, got her into a life jacket and helmet, helped her to shore, and carried her on a wheeled litter to the trailhead, where an ambulance took her to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: St. Vrain River, ~1 mi from Wild Basin trailhead
responding_agency: RMNP SAR; Estes Valley Fire Protection District dive/swiftwater team
